notes: Subject insert through multiple_of (transitive). 'Even' is being a multiple of 2 (the chain says so; firm).

queries.not_checked: fol (arithmetic): primality from a divisor (the record tags it fol)

fol.notes: Multiples and remainders are built-in arithmetic (12 is a multiple of 6 and of 2 needs no stored fact, so it never shows in a core). Primality is the model's predicate, constrained only by the stored definition, instantiated at the Pellow number and the divisor 2 the chain uses.

prime_def.says: A prime number has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.
prime_def.z3: All([n, d], [(pellow, 2)], Implies(And(prime(n), n % d == 0), Or(d == 1, d == n)))

label_corrections.why: multiple_of is transitive (Pellow multiple_of 12 multiple_of 2) and an even number other than 2 is not prime is a class axiom; 'Pellow is not 2' follows from the asymmetry of multiple_of. No arithmetic is needed.
